integrity: An analytical argument and a separate exact-rational checker support the stated limited theorem. No claim of independent validation or historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Assumes iid years, exchangeable three-site binary environments, perfect mixing, deterministic density-independent abundance and positive multipliers; does not prove finite-population survival. Full text of one closest historical source was inaccessible; priority provisional.
title: Sharp third-order dependence bounds for growth in three well-mixed habitats
